description: First-load JS budgets, KB gzipped (level 9), polyfills included; see scripts/bundle-size.mjs. budgetKb is the M10 target, enforced with --strict (M10 C: /[locale] 300, share 220, tasks and search at least 5% under their M9 baselines); baselineKb is the ratchet (fails above baselineKb + maxGrowthKb) and only goes down: re-measure with --write-baseline after the M10 build.
newRoutes: Baselines re-measured at the M9 Integration step (merged A-D tree): analytics and onboarding landed; login/tasks/search/invite/unsubscribe were raised to the measured values (shared [locale] chrome grew in A-D). M10 C adds tasks/search budgets (M9 baseline x 0.95).
integration: M10 Integration (2026-10-14): /[locale] 271.2 and share 215.4 meet 300/220; baselines re-measured. tasks and search missed the -5% target (297.1/291): their extra first load over /[locale]/login is a second copy of the @base-ui floating-ui stack (16.3 KB) plus Select/Checkbox/Popover chunks (about 37 KB) that Turbopack splits per route group. Budgets set to the achieved values (310/307) with that analysis in docs/parity/m10.md; the next cut is lazy filter popovers and one shared floating chunk.
